# SnapDeck AI — Complete Information

> Turn photos and PDFs into flashcards instantly with on-device AI.

## About SnapDeck AI

SnapDeck AI is an iOS app that transforms study materials into flashcards using Apple Intelligence. Take a photo of your textbook, lecture notes, handout, or import a PDF — SnapDeck AI reads the content and generates a complete set of question-and-answer flashcards in seconds.

All AI processing happens entirely on your iPhone using Apple's on-device Foundation Models. No internet connection is required, no data is uploaded to any server, and no accounts are needed. Your study materials remain 100% private.

## Features

### Snap & Create
Take a photo of your textbook, lecture notes, or handout. SnapDeck AI reads the content and generates a complete flashcard deck in seconds.

### On-Device AI
Powered by Apple Intelligence, all processing happens right on your iPhone. No internet required, no cloud uploads, no waiting.

### 100% Private
Your study materials never leave your device. No accounts, no data collection, no tracking. Your notes stay completely private.

### Interactive Study
Flip through cards, mark what you know and what needs review. Track your progress and master any subject efficiently.

## How It Works

1. **Snap a photo** — Take a photo of your textbook, notes, or slides. You can also import PDFs or type text manually.
2. **AI generates cards** — Apple Intelligence reads your material and creates question-and-answer flashcards automatically.
3. **Study & master** — Flip through your cards, mark progress, and review until you've mastered the material.

### Streaks & Progress
Study streaks, XP and per-deck mastery stats keep track of what has actually been learned. Dark mode is supported, and the app is available in 39 languages.

## Pricing

- **Free**: Up to 3 decks per month, with full study mode, streaks, stats and offline use
- **Premium**: Unlimited deck creation, unlimited document length, unlimited cards per deck. One-time purchase — no subscription. Unlocked inside the app; current pricing is shown on the App Store.

## System Requirements

- iPhone 15 Pro or later
- iOS 26
- Apple Intelligence enabled

## Privacy

SnapDeck AI is built with privacy as a core principle:
- No account or registration required
- No photos, PDFs, or text content is uploaded to any server
- No analytics or tracking SDKs are embedded in the app
- No cookies or identifiers are stored
- All AI processing uses Apple's on-device Foundation Models
- Flashcard decks and study progress are stored locally using Apple's SwiftData framework
- No data is synced to any cloud service

## Blog

The SnapDeck AI blog publishes practical study advice for students at https://snapdeck.12f.dk/blog/ (RSS feed: https://snapdeck.12f.dk/feed.xml). Posts are tagged `study-tips`, `memory-science` or `exam-prep`.

### How to study when you can't focus for more than ten minutes (2026-07-23, study-tips)
https://snapdeck.12f.dk/blog/focus-when-you-cant/
Focus isn't a switch you flip — it's a muscle that tires fast under pressure. This post explains why trying to study in long blocks backfires when your attention is short, and shows four concrete methods that work with a short attention span: timed sessions with real breaks, starting with the easiest material, turning passive reading into active recall, and designing a routine that doesn't depend on feeling motivated.

### The night-before-the-exam survival guide (2026-07-22, exam-prep)
https://snapdeck.12f.dk/blog/night-before-exam-survival-guide/
An hour-by-hour triage plan for the evening before an exam: spend the first hour deciding what to study (prioritising half-known, high-mark topics), convert material into questions and answer them rather than re-reading, do a final pass on the topics still missed, then sleep properly because sleep consolidates memory. Covers what to skip guilt-free and what to do on the morning of the exam.

### How to take notes you'll actually study from (2026-07-08, study-tips)
https://snapdeck.12f.dk/blog/notes-youll-actually-study-from/
Four changes that make notes usable as study material: write questions in the margin rather than only statements (the engine behind the Cornell method), photograph slides and diagrams instead of transcribing them, do a five-minute same-day pass to add questions and mark gaps, and convert notes into cards while the material is fresh rather than during exam week.

### Why cramming feels great and works terribly (2026-06-24, memory-science)
https://snapdeck.12f.dk/blog/why-cramming-feels-great/
Explains the fluency illusion — re-reading builds recognition, not recall — and the three findings that matter: Ebbinghaus's forgetting curve, the spacing effect (Cepeda et al., 2006), and the testing effect (Roediger & Karpicke, 2006). Concludes that cramming works for tomorrow but not for next month, and gives four adjustments that do not require changing habits entirely.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How does SnapDeck AI create flashcards?
Take a photo of your textbook, lecture notes, or handout — or import a PDF. SnapDeck AI uses Apple Intelligence to read the content and automatically generate question-and-answer flashcards in seconds, all on-device.

### Does SnapDeck AI require an internet connection?
No. All AI processing happens entirely on your iPhone using Apple Intelligence. No internet connection, cloud uploads, or external servers are involved.

### Is my data private with SnapDeck AI?
Yes. SnapDeck AI is 100% private. Your photos, PDFs, and study materials never leave your device. No accounts, no data collection, no tracking.

### What devices support SnapDeck AI?
SnapDeck AI requires iPhone 15 Pro or later running iOS 26 with Apple Intelligence enabled.

### Is SnapDeck AI free?
Yes, SnapDeck AI is free to use with up to 3 decks per month. A Premium upgrade is available for unlimited deck creation, unlimited document length, and unlimited cards per deck.
